summary: Validate the target: gateway dashboard at `https://<gateway_hostname>/`, controller projects, inventories and job templates, hub collections and namespaces, EDA rule audits and activations, and `podman logs <container_name>` for errors. Then run key job and workflow templates and check execution environments, job artifacts and schedules.
